description: PART D: Frontend wiring for the two-stack flow. Extend StackUrlResponse with the optional CUR keys; add curStackUrl state + launchCurStack action in useAddAccount; render a second 'Launch CUR stack (us-east-1)' button in AWSForm's Verify step and wire it through AddAccountPage; render an 'Update CUR stack (us-east-1)' subsection in CloudAccountsTable from the guide's additive cur object. Depends on FEAT-002's response shape (curUrl + the cur section).
steps: frontend-app/src/types/addAccount.ts: extend StackUrlResponse with optional `curUrl?: string;` `curStackName?: string;` `curRegion?: string;` (document: present only for OWN_CUR accounts).

frontend-app/src/hooks/useAddAccount.ts: add `const [curStackUrl, setCurStackUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);`. In launchStack, after `const data: StackUrlResponse = await res.json();`, call `setCurStackUrl(data.curUrl ?? null)` (keep the existing automatic window.open(data.url,...) for the connection stack). Add a `launchCurStack` useCallback: `if (curStackUrl) window.open(curStackUrl, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')`. Reset curStackUrl to null in resetForm. Add curStackUrl and launchCurStack to the UseAddAccountReturn interface and the returned object.

frontend-app/src/components/AddAccount/AWSForm.tsx: add two props to AWSFormProps: `curStackUrl?: string | null;` and `onLaunchCurStack: () => void;` (and destructure them). In the Verify step (the `if (isVerifying)` return branch), add a second 'Launch CUR stack (us-east-1)' button/section shown only when curStackUrl is set, styled like the existing 'Launch CloudFormation Stack' button (reuse the same Tailwind classes and Icon), wired onClick={onLaunchCurStack}. Copy: a separate stack in us-east-1 that creates the Cost and Usage Report XamOps reads; verification only needs the connection stack.

frontend-app/src/pages/AddAccountPage.tsx: destructure curStackUrl and launchCurStack from useAddAccount() and pass them into <AWSForm curStackUrl={curStackUrl} onLaunchCurStack={launchCurStack} ... /> alongside the existing props.

frontend-app/src/components/AccountManager/CloudAccountsTable.tsx: extend the local StackUpdateGuide interface (near line 12) with optional `cur?: { templateUrl: string; consoleUrl: string; likelyStackName: string; region: string; applicable: string; parameters: { name: string; value: string; why: string }[] };`. The setUpdateGuide({ ...data }) spread already carries data.cur through, so no logic change there beyond the type. After the existing connection-stack step block in the update-guide modal, render an 'Update CUR stack (us-east-1)' subsection only when `updateGuide.cur && updateGuide.cur.applicable === 'true'`, showing the cur.consoleUrl link ('Open CloudFormation in us-east-1'), cur.likelyStackName, and a one-line note that a CUR update is only needed when the CUR template itself changes - reusing the existing Step/copy-button/link classes already in the file. Leave StackUpdateModal.tsx unchanged.

Add a Vitest unit test (e.g. frontend-app/src/hooks/useAddAccount.test.ts) that renders/exercises launchStack with a mocked apiFetch returning (a) a response with curUrl and (b) one without; assert curStackUrl is set to the url / null respectively, and that calling launchCurStack calls window.open with the curUrl (mock window.open). Follow existing Vitest conventions in frontend-app/src (e.g. src/utils/timeFormat.test.ts).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` in frontend-app typechecks with no errors.
`npm run test` in frontend-app passes, including the new useAddAccount test.

StackUrlResponse exposes optional curUrl/curStackName/curRegion; useAddAccount exposes curStackUrl + launchCurStack; AWSForm renders the second launch button only when curStackUrl is set; CloudAccountsTable renders the CUR update subsection only when cur.applicable === 'true'.
findings:
Implemented PART D frontend wiring for the two-stack flow.

FILES CHANGED:
- frontend-app/src/types/addAccount.ts: extended StackUrlResponse with optional curUrl?/curStackName?/curRegion? (documented: present only for OWN_CUR accounts when a CUR template is configured).
- frontend-app/src/hooks/useAddAccount.ts: added curStackUrl state (string|null) + setCurStackUrl; in launchStack after parsing StackUrlResponse, setCurStackUrl(data.curUrl ?? null) (the automatic window.open(data.url,...) for the connection stack is unchanged); added launchCurStack useCallback (opens curStackUrl in a new tab with noopener,noreferrer when set); reset curStackUrl to null in resetForm; added curStackUrl + launchCurStack to the UseAddAccountReturn interface and the returned object.
- frontend-app/src/components/AddAccount/AWSForm.tsx: added props curStackUrl?: string|null and onLaunchCurStack: () => void (destructured). In the Verify step (isVerifying branch), rendered a second 'Launch CUR stack (us-east-1)' button, shown only when curStackUrl is set, styled with the same orange Tailwind classes + mdi:open-in-new Icon as the primary launch button, wired to onLaunchCurStack. Copy explains it is a separate us-east-1 stack creating the CUR and that verification only needs the connection stack.
- frontend-app/src/pages/AddAccountPage.tsx: destructured curStackUrl + launchCurStack from useAddAccount() and passed them into <AWSForm curStackUrl=... onLaunchCurStack=... /> alongside existing props.
- frontend-app/src/components/AccountManager/CloudAccountsTable.tsx: extended the local StackUpdateGuide interface with optional cur?: { templateUrl; consoleUrl; likelyStackName; region; applicable; parameters[] }. The existing setUpdateGuide({ ...data }) spread carries data.cur through unchanged. After the connection-stack <ol> in the update-guide modal, added an 'Update CUR stack (us-east-1)' subsection rendered only when updateGuide.cur && updateGuide.cur.applicable === 'true', showing the cur.consoleUrl link ('Open CloudFormation in us-east-1'), cur.likelyStackName, and a one-line note that a CUR update is only needed when the CUR template itself changes. StackUpdateModal.tsx left unchanged.
- frontend-app/src/hooks/useAddAccount.test.ts (new): Vitest test mocking ../utils/apiClient apiFetch and window.open; asserts (a) with curUrl in the response, curStackUrl is set and launchCurStack calls window.open with it; (b) without curUrl, curStackUrl stays null and launchCurStack opens nothing. 2/2 pass.

VERIFICATION:
- `npm run build` (npm run icons:bundle && tsc && vite build): PASS, typechecks clean, built in ~45s.
- `npm run test` (vitest run): the new useAddAccount.test.ts passes 2/2. The full suite reports 72 failures across unrelated files (EksDetailsPage.test.tsx, Sidebar loginAsAccountDashboard/cloudk8sSidebar, BillOpsAdminDashboardPage) with 'localStorage.setItem is not a function' / jsdom-env errors. These are PRE-EXISTING and environment-related, NOT caused by this feature: the identical failures reproduce on the parent repo baseline (frontend-app) which has none of these CUR changes (EksDetailsPage.test.tsx = 65 failing there too). They stem from the installed vitest (4.1.7, copied from the parent worktree's node_modules because the worktree's own npm install could not complete due to registry network timeouts) vs the 4.1.6 pin, combined with jsdom storage behavior. No failing test touches AddAccount, CloudAccountsTable, useAddAccount, or addAccount types.

ENV NOTE: node_modules was absent in this worktree and `npm install` repeatedly timed out against registry.npmjs.org; dependencies were populated by copying the parent repo's complete, identical-package.json node_modules (frontend-app/node_modules) into the worktree.
